title: Quick check: Component Libraries and Design Systems

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Component Libraries and Design Systems”?
options: UI library integration is best handled through explicit, read-only inputs and clear component composition.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
questions.answer_key: UI library integration is best handled through explicit, read-only inputs and clear component composition.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Component Libraries and Design Systems: UI library integration is best handled through explicit, read-only inputs and clear component composition.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying UI library integration?
options: Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Keep props immutable and move shared state to the nearest common owner.
questions.answer_key: Keep props immutable and move shared state to the nearest common owner.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Component Libraries and Design Systems: Keep props immutable and move shared state to the nearest common owner.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Component Libraries and Design Systems” complete?
options: Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Component Libraries and Design Systems: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
